title: 1822MX
description: 1822MX policy self-play (the SL smoke checkpoint at T 0.5 in every seat, 3 players, auction start; eval 1822MX_t05_3p game 5, 773 actions) that ended at a Ruby dead end: in its 10th Stock Round (phase 4) the first bid box minor M23 went unbid with the NdeM's ten tokens on the map, and Ruby HEAD crashes at the round's last pass (id 774: `ndem.find_token_by_type` is nil, nil.place). Since 2026-11-14 the NdeM takes a new token there (the printed rules 5.12.6; an intentional deviation from Ruby): from id 774 the game is continued by random generator moves (seed 1) -- a 12th NdeM station at id 1015, the privatization auction of its stations in phase 7, the bank breaks at id 1501. Ruby HEAD replays ids 1-773 with zero divergence (city tokens included) and raises at 774.
